As a Petrophysical Analyst, you will independently perform specialist SCAL analyses on rock samples. You will work on your own projects, interpret data and maintain contact with clients.

- Working with specialist SCAL techniques, such as capillary pressure measurements, Archie parameters, NMR and wettability studies

- Assessing, interpreting and reporting laboratory data
